ada.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic woman in her mid thirties, one of two identical twins, doll-like: a head a little too big, very pale porcelain skin, platinum blond hair in a severe chin-length bob with a blunt straight fringe, nearly invisible white eyebrows, huge pale grey eyes set too far apart, a tiny nose, a tiny closed mouth, a very long thin neck; a small dark mole just under her right eye; in a mustard-yellow knitted cardigan buttoned up over a white blouse with a round collar

parti.occhi: Huge pale grey eyes set too far apart under a blunt platinum fringe, with nearly invisible white eyebrows and lashes; a small dark mole just under her right eye; the whites are clear and the pale skin is cool: no fever.
parti.occhi_febbre: Huge pale grey eyes set too far apart under a blunt platinum fringe, glassy and red-rimmed with fever, the pale cheeks flushed; a small dark mole just under her right eye.
parti.bocca: A tiny closed mouth with pale pink lips in a pale porcelain face; healthy; nothing unusual.

collo.inquadratura: her very long, thin neck above the round white collar of her blouse
collo.segni: A very long, thin, pale neck, smooth and healthy: no swelling, no lumps.

ascelle.inquadratura: her left armpit and the inside of her raised upper arm, nothing else: the sleeve of the mustard cardigan pushed up to the shoulder, while the white blouse and the cardigan still cover her chest and her side completely
ascelle.segni: Pale, healthy skin in the armpit, with no swelling and no marks at all.

mani.inquadratura: both hands held out in front, backs up, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Long, thin, pale fingers with short clean nails; the tip of the left index finger is covered with tiny needle pricks, as of someone who sews all day; otherwise healthy.

lia.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic woman in her mid thirties, one of two identical twins, doll-like: a head a little too big, very pale porcelain skin under a thick layer of pale face powder, platinum blond hair in a severe chin-length bob with a blunt straight fringe, nearly invisible white eyebrows, huge pale grey eyes set too far apart, a tiny nose, a tiny closed mouth, a very long thin neck; no mole; in a mustard-yellow knitted cardigan buttoned up over a white blouse with a round collar

parti.occhi: Huge pale grey eyes set too far apart under a blunt platinum fringe, glassy and red-rimmed with fever; under a thick layer of white face powder the cheeks are flushed red, and at the temples the powder is cracked and streaked by sweat; no mole under the eyes.
parti.bocca: A tiny mouth with pale, dry, cracked lips under the face powder; nothing else.

collo.inquadratura: her very long, thin neck above the round white collar of her blouse
collo.segni: A very long, thin, pale neck shining with sweat under the powder; no swelling, no lumps on the neck.

ascelle.inquadratura: her left armpit and the inside of her raised upper arm, nothing else: the sleeve of the mustard cardigan pushed up to the shoulder, while the white blouse and the cardigan still cover her chest and her side completely
ascelle.segni: In the armpit a hard swollen lump the size of an egg, dark red and shiny: a plague bubo; the skin around it hot and wet.

mani.inquadratura: both hands held out in front, backs up, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Long, thin, pale fingers, damp with sweat and slightly trembling; the tip of the right index finger is covered with tiny needle pricks, as of someone who sews all day.
